questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
Select the option that correctly reports the statement: 'I am writing an email to my boss.'
options: He said he was writing an email to his boss.
He said he is writing an email to his boss.
He said he writes an email to his boss.
He said he will write an email to his boss.
questions.answer: He said he was writing an email to his boss.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information?
options: It is said that the project was completed on time.
It is said that the project completes on time.
It is said that the project is completing on time.
It is said that the project will complete on time.
questions.answer: It is said that the project was completed on time.

questions.question: Choose the correct dependent preposition: By the time we arrived, the train ________ already left.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'If I find her number, I'll call her.'
options: He said that if he found her number, he would call her.
He said that if he finds her number, he would call her.
He said that if he had found her number, he would call her.
He said that if he will find her number, he calls her.
questions.answer: He said that if he found her number, he would call her.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses a discourse marker to introduce a contrasting idea?
options: On the other hand, the results were disappointing.
In conclusion, the results were disappointing.
questions.answer: On the other hand, the results were disappointing.

questions.question: Choose the correct collocation: She decided to take a ________ from her studies for a month.
Select the appropriate word to complete the phrase: 'It's ________ to say that she was surprised.'
Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional to report a past unreal condition?
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I knew about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I had known about the meeting, I would attend.
If I know about the meeting, I would have attended.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
